@EternalEve 谢谢，我看了 [#27](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/27)。双层是另一条路：图案和数据各占一层，容量不再受图案限制，代价是你说的对比度和换层的工程问题。不过我猜 L0 的图案区一样可能读不出，所以文件系统要放在能读的位置，这一点没有验证过。

我们到现在只测过单层的 DVD-R 和 CD-R，没有双层盘的数据，判断不了可不可行。我先把 #27 记进主帖，单层这边有结论后再看。
双层盘是，先L0内到外，再切到L1外到内这样写吗？那为何不是数据在L0图案放外边L1呢，即能直接挂载fs又能把图案放在外面那层。双层盘不知道现在用这个项目只刻第一层的话会有什么效果，我手上只有BD-RE DL，用威宝的那个预设去弄反正是一点东西没看出来。全黑黢黢。

@bczhc 下面是按标准说的，我们没有实测过双层盘。

DVD 双层一般是这样写：先 L0 从内到外，再 L1 从外到内。你的想法卡在 DVD 和 BD 的层序相反：

- DVD：L0 离激光近，L1 在后面。数据放 L0、图案放 L1，图案要隔着 L0 看，所以 #27 才说图案放 L0。代价是 L0 不好放文件系统。
- BD：L0 在深处，L1 离激光近。所以先写的 L0 放数据、L1 放图案，几何上正好是你说的那样，从前面看图案也不用隔一层。

不过 DIS 现在还不支持双层（#27 还开着），所以这只是思路。

你的 BD-RE DL 全黑，我判断不了原因。如果只刻了 L0，图案是隔着没写过的 L1 看的，这可能有影响；单层预设的几何也不一定适用于双层盘。这两点都是猜测。

> 双层盘是，先L0内到外，再切到L1外到内这样写吗？那为何不是数据在L0图案放外边L1呢，即能直接挂载fs又能把图案放在外面那层。双层盘不知道现在用这个项目只刻第一层的话会有什么效果，我手上只有BD-RE DL，用威宝的那个预设去弄反正是一点东西没看出来。全黑黢黢。

L0是靠近激光头的表层，L1是里层。现在作者这个项目没有做对双层的兼容
双层在可写入空间上并非是简单的4.7+4.7，所以按照单层dvd的数据规格，就会有一部分在L1中
最离谱的是+R与-R在细节上区别还不小，所以要适配双层确实相当麻烦
哦哦那是我想反了 原来L0表层L1里层

这个想法第一次有了实盘结果：一张 RITEKF1 DVD-R 上，图案区约七成的地方既是画面也存着数据，一共 1.38 GB。在 GH70N 上整盘读回没有错误，数据全部一致。这只是一台光驱、一张盘。细节在 [#170](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/170)。

Update: this idea now has a first result on a real disc. On one RITEKF1 DVD-R, about 70% of the picture area is both picture and data, 1.38 GB in all. A whole-disc read on a GH70N had no errors, and all the data matched. It's one drive and one disc. Details are in [#170](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/170).

title: On CD, where is the head when a read completes? / CD 读完一个扇区时，光头到底在盘上哪里？
body: [中文版点这里](#zh) We measure a CD's spiral from read timing, and there's one number timing can't give us. WindowsNoEditor and arkwise hit the same problem. Our results are spread across [#78](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/78), [#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107) and [#130](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/130), so I've put them together here. We don't know what causes it. If you're looking into this too, or you know how drive firmware and decoders work, I'd love to hear from you. ## The problem We spin the drive at a constant speed and alternate reads of two sectors. The gap between their completion times gives the angle between them on the disc. To do that, we have to assume where the head is when a read finishes. If that assumption is off by a fixed length of track, the fit still looks fine. You only find out when you burn a picture and the radial lines come out twisted, more near the center, following `c + a/r`. We call this length the along-track constant and count it in frames. One CD frame is 588 channel bits, about 0.163 mm of track or 24 user bytes. At 206 frames, the lines twist about 37° between 26.7 and 54.4 mm. Our assumption comes from ECMA-130: the read finishes where the sector's last byte lands after CIRC interleaving, `n_end(LBA) = ((LBA + 1) * 98 + 108)` frames. The constant is how much later the real position is. ## What's been measured | Read | Burn | Disc | Constant | How it was found | |---|---|---|---|---| | GH70N, READ(12) + FUA | IMAPI, Mode 2 Form 1, 8x | CMC CD-R (97:26:66) | about +206 frames | Radial lines on grid discs; a second disc corrected by 206 left +0.6 frames | | SN-208FB (arkwise) | cdrdao, Mode 1, DAO, 10x | Gigastorage CD-R | about +7 frames (±3) | Fit to a lamp photo of one grid disc, not yet checked on a second | | BU20N, READ CD (WindowsNoEditor) | IMAPI raw DAO, audio | Lenovo Thinkplus CD-R | about 0 (±100 bytes, about ±4 frames) | The burned diameter came out symmetric | | PLDS DU-8A5LH, READ CD (WindowsNoEditor) | The same disc, burned on the BU20N | POSO CD-R | about 25 frames below the BU20N (−603 bytes) | Timing on one disc; the geometry agrees apart from this | The last two rows use WindowsNoEditor's model, which starts from a slightly different point, so compare them with ours only by size. One more comparison with the same disc type: [moodyos](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19421856) measured a CD-R with the same ATIP as ours (97:26:66) on an ASUS SDRW-08D2S-U. The pitch matches ours at 1.504922 µm, and r0 is 25.27959 mm against our 25.27929 mm. If the discs are physically identical, that 0.30 µm is about 190 frames of difference in this constant between the two drives. A real difference between the two discs would look the same, so this doesn't settle anything yet. The same disc measured in both drives would. I think most of this comes from reading. In the first two rows, the measuring disc and the pattern disc were written the same way, so a write offset should cancel as long as writing is repeatable. The last row is one disc in another drive, so that difference has to come from reading. That makes the GH70N's 206 frames the odd one out. This is only an argument, and nobody has measured it directly. If the two discs are written differently, say a random disc from Windows' burner and a pattern from DIS, the difference between the write paths gets added in. Nobody has measured that separately yet. ## What we've ruled out A fixed time delay cancels when we subtract, and the twist we scanned does follow `1/r`, so this is a length of track. The command doesn't seem to matter much. READ(12) and READ CD differ by −2.9 ± 2.1 frames on the GH70N, and WindowsNoEditor found that channel choices stay within about ±2 frames on the BU20N. The read-back offset doesn't work as a correction either. On the BU20N, audio reads back 532 bytes earlier than the written file, and correcting by that put a burned diameter about 1 cm out of line. On the PLDS the offset is −144 bytes, and the gap between those two doesn't match the gap in the constant. WindowsNoEditor also checked `CddaInterleaveTable` in DIS: bytes land +111 frames after their file position, close to our 108 but not the same. ## What we can't explain On the GH70N, a read finishes at about `(LBA + 1) * 98 + 314` frames, which is 2 sectors plus 118 frames. An AI literature search turned up a 118-frame CIRC delay in the NXP SAF784x manual. That's a different chip with a different starting point, and we haven't checked the source, so it may well be a coincidence. The model's own span from sector start to end of decoding is also 206 frames, which makes the total of 412 exactly double. That may be a coincidence too, since 206 also equals 2 × 98 + 10, and whole-number splits like these can't pick a mechanism. A few frames may not come from decoding at all. If the path of the read spot is offset from the disc's center by `h`, that adds `h/r` to the angle, the same shape as a fixed length of track. An offset of 0.5 mm looks like about 3 frames, which matters for 0 ± 4 and 7 ± 3 but can't explain 206. We also looked up the chips, and it doesn't settle anything yet. An AI search found that Dell's GH70N firmware identifies itself internally as `GH72L`, in an LG Renesas format, and that other samples of the BU20N and SN-208FB are recorded with MediaTek MT1959 and MT1895N. None of this has been confirmed on the drives measured here, so a split like Renesas against MediaTek is only a guess. The most useful next test is one data CD read on the GH70N and on another drive that has already been checked. We also don't know why DVD doesn't show this clearly. Ritek F1 DVD-R on the GH70N got within about 0.1° from timing alone, on the first burn. ## Questions 1. How long after CIRC decoding does a READ usually return? Is a difference of a hundred frames or more between chips plausible? 2. Is anyone else looking into this, or have you seen a similar offset elsewhere? 3. If you have an RF capture setup or a logic analyzer, could you measure where the head is when the command completes? ## Tests you can run without burning a picture You need a random-data disc and [disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe). The measurement only reads the disc. The drive has to be CAV, so run `timing` first. To get another read-side difference, run this on one random CD in two drives and post both `summary.json` files: ```bash python -m discprobe geo --media cd --drive E: --speed 1411 --host-delay-ms 35 --ranges 2000-356000 ``` To look at the write path, burn random data on two discs of one batch in two ways, say Windows' own burner and ImgBurn, then run the same command on both in one drive. We haven't tried this, and differences between the two discs may hide the effect. ## What we're doing next We'll burn a calibration disc in DIS using the GH70N measurement. The measuring disc was written by IMAPI and this one by DIS (its CD calibration disc may be an audio track), so it should show 206 frames plus the difference between those write paths. I'll update this post when we have it. Our records are in [KNOWLEDGE.md section 12](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/blob/main/docs/KNOWLEDGE.md), the [CD physical model](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/blob/main/docs/CD_PHYSICAL_MODEL.md) and [our measurements](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/tree/main/evidence/cd-geo-20261104). WindowsNoEditor's are in [#78](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/78#issuecomment-6627881569) and [#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19411985). @WindowsNoEditor @arkwise I've quoted your results here, so please correct anything I got wrong. --- ## 中文版 我们用读取计时测 CD 的螺旋几何，有一个数计时测不出来。WindowsNoEditor 和 arkwise 也碰到了。大家的结果散在 [#78](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/78)、[#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107) 和 [#130](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/130) 里，我放到一起。原因我们还不知道。如果你也在查，或者懂光驱固件和解码，很想听听你的看法。 ### 问题是什么 我们让光驱匀速转，交替读两个扇区，用两次读完的时间差算它们在盘上的夹角。这一步要先假设：读完的那一刻，光头在盘上哪里。 如果这个假设差了一段固定长度的轨道，拟合看起来还是好好的。要等刻了图才发现径向线是扭的，越靠近圆心扭得越多，形状是 `c + a/r`。这段长度我们叫沿轨道常数，用帧来数。CD 的一帧是 588 个通道位，约 0.163 mm 轨道，也就是 24 个用户字节。如果是 206 帧，从 26.7 mm 到 54.4 mm 线会扭约 37°。 我们的假设来自 ECMA-130：读完的位置，是扇区最后一个字节经 CIRC 交织后落下的地方，`n_end(LBA) = ((LBA + 1) * 98 + 108)` 帧。沿轨道常数就是实际位置比这里还晚多少。 ### 目前测到的 | 读取 | 刻录 | 盘 | 常数 | 怎么定的 | |---|---|---|---|---| | GH70N，READ(12) + FUA | IMAPI，Mode 2 Form 1，8x | CMC CD-R（97:26:66） | 约 +206 帧 | 网格盘的径向线；按 206 修正后，第二张盘还剩 +0.6 帧 | | SN-208FB（arkwise） | cdrdao，Mode 1，DAO，10x | Gigastorage CD-R | 约 +7 帧（±3） | 一张网格盘的灯光照片拟合，还没用第二张验证 | | BU20N，READ CD（WindowsNoEditor） | IMAPI raw DAO，音轨 | 联想 Thinkplus CD-R | 约 0（±100 字节，约 ±4 帧） | 实刻的直径是对称的 | | PLDS DU-8A5LH，READ CD（WindowsNoEditor） | BU20N 刻的同一张盘 | 海存 POSO CD-R | 比 BU20N 小约 25 帧（−603 字节） | 同一张盘分别计时，几何一致，只差这一项 | 后两行用的是 WindowsNoEditor 的模型，起点和我们略有不同，所以和我们的数只能比大小。 还有一个同款盘的比较：[moodyos](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19421856) 用 ASUS SDRW-08D2S-U 测了一张 ATIP 和我们相同（97:26:66）的 CD-R。轨距和我们一样，都是 1.504922 µm，r0 是 25.27959 mm，我们是 25.27929 mm。如果两张盘的物理结构完全相同，这 0.30 µm 相当于两台光驱在这个常数上差约 190 帧。不过两张盘本身不同也会是这个样子，所以现在还定不下来。用两台光驱测同一张盘就能分清。 我觉得差别主要来自读取。前两行里，测量盘和图案盘的写法相同，只要每次写的位置可重复，写入的偏移就应该抵消。最后一行是同一张盘换光驱，差别只能来自读取。这么看，GH70N 的 206 帧是最特别的。不过这只是推理，还没有人直接测过。 如果两张盘写法不同，比如随机盘用 Windows 自带刻录，图案用 DIS 刻，还要再加上两种写法的差。这个差还没有人单独测过。 ### 已经排除的 固定的时间延迟在相减时就抵消了，而扫描量到的扭转确实符合 `1/r`，所以这是一段轨道长度。 读取命令的影响看起来不大。GH70N 上 READ(12) 和 READ CD 差 −2.9 ± 2.1 帧；WindowsNoEditor 在 BU20N 上试了不同的通道选择，差别在约 ±2 帧以内。 读回偏移也不能拿来修正。BU20N 读回的音频比写入文件早 532 字节，按这个修正后，刻出的直径错开了约 1 cm。PLDS 上这个偏移是 −144 字节，两台的差和沿轨道常数的差也对不上。 WindowsNoEditor 还核对了 DIS 的 `CddaInterleaveTable`：字节比文件位置晚 +111 帧，和我们的 108 帧很接近，但不一样。 ### 解释不了的 GH70N 读完的位置约在 `(LBA + 1) * 98 + 314` 帧，等于 2 个扇区加 118 帧。AI 调研查到 NXP SAF784x 手册里 CIRC 数据延迟是 118 帧。那是另一颗芯片，起点也不一样，我们没有核实过原文，很可能只是巧合。模型里从扇区开头到解码结束也正好是 206 帧，加上实测多出的 206 帧总共 412 帧，刚好翻倍，这也可能是巧合，因为 206 同样等于 2 × 98 + 10，这种整数拆分选不出机制。 几帧的差别也不一定来自解码。如果读取光点的运动线偏离圆心 `h`，转角会多出 `h/r`，形状和一段固定的轨道长度相同。偏 0.5 mm 看起来就像约 3 帧，这对 0 ± 4 和 7 ± 3 有影响，但解释不了 206。 我们也查了芯片，目前还定不了什么。AI 调研查到 Dell 的 GH70N 固件内部标识是 `GH72L`，是 LG Renesas 的格式；BU20N、SN-208FB 的其他样本记录的是 MediaTek MT1959、MT1895N。这些都没有在这里测的光驱上确认过，所以“Renesas 对 MediaTek”只是猜测。下一步最有用的是同一张数据 CD 在 GH70N 和另一台已验证的光驱上对照。 DVD 上为什么不明显，我们也不知道。GH70N 读 Ritek F1 DVD-R，只靠计时、第一次刻录，径向线只差约 0.1°。 ### 想问问大家 1. READ 命令通常在 CIRC 解码之后多久返回？不同芯片差上百帧合理吗？ 2. 还有人在查这个吗？或者在别的地方见过类似的偏移吗？ 3. 手上有 RF 采集设备或逻辑分析仪的话，能不能直接测命令完成时光头在哪？ ### 不用刻图也能帮忙 只要一张随机数据盘和 [disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe)，测量只读盘。光驱要是 CAV 才能测，先跑一次 `timing`。 想多一组读取方面的差值，就把同一张随机 CD 放到两台光驱上各跑一次，发两份 `summary.json`： ```bash python -m discprobe geo --media cd --drive E: --speed 1411 --host-delay-ms 35 --ranges 2000-356000 ``` 想看写法的影响，就用同一批的两张盘，用两种方式写随机数据（比如 Windows 自带刻录和 ImgBurn），再在同一台光驱上各跑一次。这个我们还没试过，两张盘本身的差别也可能把它盖住。 ### 我们接下来做什么 用 GH70N 的测量结果在 DIS 里刻一张标定盘。测量盘是 IMAPI 写的，这张是 DIS 写的（它的 CD 标定盘可能是音轨），所以量到的应该是 206 帧加上两种写法的差。有结果我再更新到这里。 我们的记录在 [KNOWLEDGE.md 第 12 节](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/blob/main/docs/KNOWLEDGE.md)、[CD 物理模型](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/blob/main/docs/CD_PHYSICAL_MODEL.md)和[测量数据](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/tree/main/evidence/cd-geo-20261104)。WindowsNoEditor 的结果在 [#78](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/78#issuecomment-6627881569) 和 [#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19411985)。 @WindowsNoEditor @arkwise 这里引用了你们的结果，有写错的地方麻烦指正。

nodes.body:
补两个相关的数，都来自 @WindowsNoEditor 在 [#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107#discussioncomment-19432739) 的测量，已征得同意：

- **同样的 ATIP，几何也可能不同。** banana CD-R 和海存 POSO 都是 97:27:18、359849 扇区。banana 的内、外半径分别比海存小约 108 nm 和 116 nm，轨距只差 3 ppm。两张都是同一台 HP 刻、同一台 HP 读，读偏移 s 都是 −532 字节，所以沿轨道常数没有变。而且纯沿轨道平移只会让外半径的变化是内半径的约 0.43 倍，这里是 1.07 倍。所以是两种盘的螺旋本身不同。moodyos 那张差约 0.30 µm，也不一定要靠光驱解释。
- **刻录机这一侧的差别很小。** 同一台 HP 读两台刻录机刻的盘，读偏移 s 相差 144 字节（PLDS 刻的 −388，HP 刻的 −532），约 6 帧。

title: 感觉拍照拍不出比较明显的图案，大家有遇到过类似问题吗？
body: 采用盘体：威宝 DVD-R AZO(43533) 刻录机：PLDS DVD-RW DS8A8SH，MID：MCC 03RG20 每一张图在刻录之前会在PS精调一下对比度和明暗程度，然后控制抖动尽可能小，亮度视情况±20左右 不知道是不是这个盘体最极限的成像表现就到这了，还是我房间光线问题，或者是拍照角度/设备问题 给我的感觉是肉眼看着还不错，但是拍出来就没那感觉了 放几张给大家看看，帮我挑挑毛病，附带原图

nodes.body: 和盘有关系，有的盘效果不明显
如果你肉眼看着不错，那就是你拍摄角度的问题，试试不同的角度拍摄

@ShawnZhou2000 图其实刻得不错，你肉眼看着好，说明问题主要在拍摄这边。几张照片都能看出轮廓，比如第 3 张上半部分的人物就比较清楚，那块盘面映到的正好是暗处。 光盘的数据面像一面镜子，手机拍到的主要是它映出来的东西。屋里的灯和亮的墙、天花板把盘面映成一片发白发紫，图就被盖住了。每条彩色亮线也差不多对应一盏灯或一块很亮的地方，所以照片里才有那么多条。 可以这样试试： 1. 关掉屋里的灯，只留一盏小灯。手机手电筒也行，或者把显示器调成黑底，中间开一个小白方块。 2. 灯放在手机旁边，都离盘远一点。约 1 米最好，放不下就尽量远。 3. 盘稍微歪一点，让它映出的是暗处，不是灯。在屏幕上慢慢转动，盘面一暗，图就会显出来。 4. 手机对焦后，把曝光往下拉一点。手机默认会把暗处提亮，图和背景的差别就被抹平了。 5. 盘后面和手机后面尽量是暗的，手也别离盘太近，免得映进去。 这是我们在 DVD 上试过的方法，这种盘我们没试过，效果不敢保证。 @SODIUMWATER 说和盘有关也对，不同的盘对比度确实不一样。如果想分清是盘还是拍摄的问题，手边有平板扫描仪的话扫一张就行，扫描不受屋里反光的影响。 另外，大块明暗分明的图通常比细线和灰阶多的图更容易显出来，你第 6 张那种可以优先拿来试拍。

title: 【早期结果】在普通 DVD-R 上刻出按颜色设计的图：部分花瓣显出接近原图的紫色 / [Early result] A colour-designed picture on a plain DVD-R: some petals come close to the original purple
body:
平时在光盘上刻图，软件会先把彩色图片变成黑白明暗。盘上看到的颜色，是光盘自己反光带来的彩虹，不是你选的。 这张盘我们试了另一种做法：先定好颜色，再算出每一小块该刻什么。用的是普通刻录机和普通空白盘，没有改任何硬件。找到合适的角度时，部分花瓣显出了接近原图的紫色。 这是用一张盘做的早期结果，局限都写在后面。 左边是用 GPT Image 生成的原图，中间和右边是刻好的盘的照片，背景已遮掉。 ## 颜色怎么来的 光盘背面的彩虹，来自盘上细密重复的纹路。纹路的间距不同，同一个方向上看到的颜色就不同，而这个间距是可以靠写入的数据改变的。 所以我们先定好相机和灯的位置，再给每个小格选一个间距，让红光或蓝光刚好射向相机。花瓣里的红格和蓝格混在一起，看起来就是紫色。盘上不同位置需要的间距不一样，所以每一小块都要单独算。 ## 现在的效果 - 右图主玫瑰的中部和花心，颜色和原图几乎一样，只是暗一些。 - 同一张照片里，主玫瑰上部偏玫红，右上偏橙红，所以还没有整张变对。 - 中图的花瓣整片偏玫红，比原图红。相隔很远的几处颜色却很接近，看起来按位置计算起了作用。 - 轻轻晃动时，整片颜色会一起变，从绿到红。这本身就很好看。 - 画面有一种没想到的磨砂质感，原因还没弄清。 ## 还没做到的 - 只在一个角度看起来对。手机稍微一动，花瓣就会变绿或变红。它更像是“在某个位置看的图”，不是印刷品。 - 盘上有两个扇形显不出这种颜色，所以图的上下两块只有明暗。 - 目前只做了紫色这一种目标，还不是能显示任意颜色的“真彩色”。 - 拍摄角度是手动找的，灯用的是 iPad 手电筒，不是我们计算时假设的手机闪光灯，位置也没量。有一张更早的近距离照片和计算结果对不上，所以还不能说计算已经被证实。 - 只有一张盘和几张手机照片，手机自己的色彩处理也会影响看到的颜色。 - 我们的程序还没发布，想先整理和测试。 这张盘同时还存了 1.38 GB 数据，那是另一件事，单独写在这里：[#170](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/170)。 更早的讨论：[颜色 #108](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/108)。
颜色算法（实验性） 这是我们现在用来算纹路的方法，还在实验阶段，不保证换一张盘、一个机位也能用。 ``` p = 盘上的点, t = 该点的轨道切向（单位向量） u_L, u_C = 从 p 指向灯、相机的单位向量 delta = |(u_L + u_C) · t| P_red = 0.625 / delta # µm P_blue = 0.455 / delta if P_red <= 2.133 and P_blue >= 0.853: # 能显色的区域 want_r = R / scale # R、B 是原图的线性值 want_b = 1.6 * B / scale # 红线约比蓝线强，所以蓝要多一些 误差扩散：max(want_r, want_b) > 0.5 时选红格或蓝格，否则写暗写法 红格用最接近 P_red 的序列，蓝格用最接近 P_blue 的序列 else: 按亮度误差扩散，写亮写法或暗写法 # 上下两块只有明暗 ``` - `scale` 取原图 `R + 1.6 B` 的 99.5 分位。1.6 是折中值：少量实测里红线约是蓝线的 2 倍，模型里差不多一样强。 - 设计位置：相机在盘心外 13.5 cm、高 54 cm，闪光灯相对镜头偏 (−43.66, +19.79) mm，取自 Apple 的尺寸图。 - 小格约 0.06 mm 径向、0.075 到 0.16 mm 沿轨。 可用的序列（周期 µm 和扰码后的字节，重复写入）。模型里谱线占比 58% 到 69%，F512 不超过 0.37%： ``` 0.853 A7A7 0.878 61A73E6377A462 0.889 6377A461E2 0.898 E2A5A461E2A5A461 0.914 F8E2A5 0.933 A7C8F83F5AE474 0.948 5AE45AE4 0.970 B66EE4A1E1 0.984 EE6EE4EE6EE4 0.995 E411E8E10CEE6E 1.004 EE6E9E40EE6E9E40 1.010 A36F66E411A16EE10C 1.016 AF66E440EEAF66E440EE 1.024 6F667E4847EE6F667E4847EE 1.032 6FAD66C2481147E8AF66C4480C47EE 1.066 6F 1.103 326F5847BB57FC66356F5747BF5766 1.113 6F94BB57CE676F94BB57CE67 1.123 3598BB57663598BB5766 1.129 6F94BFCE6798BBC666 1.137 98BBC66798BBC667 1.148 3594BF3298BBFC 1.163 6781C66781C6 1.185 CCCE986467 1.219 CC7DCC7D 1.244 CC5DA45CAD467D 1.280 AD865D 1.312 975C66B7975C66B7 1.333 66B7974398 1.357 66F9B7975C9A98 1.365 FDB7B0975C9A9866FDB7B0975C9A9866 1.371 B786975C9A988866F9 1.380 B786869B5CC7988866FDB7 1.391 9B5C5CC76A988866FDB9B7B7718686 1.422 7171 1.459 884298D69A8244B07171F9B921 1.466 B9FD457C989AD48286B0B2 1.477 2188D69A824471F9B9 1.484 B2B92188D69A44B0B2B92188D69A44B0 1.493 2188C7D44471F9 1.524 F94580D4B0 1.551 B9459A69437CD469 1.600 806943 1.631 D1694380B24AD4438069CDD4B2 1.641 CDD4B2FF69CDD4B2FF69 1.659 80B2D169CDD443 1.706 C5DBC5DB 1.733 8D4DD4CD4ECDD24A6BFFB2C038 1.745 8D4D4ECDACD16BFFDB 1.756 DB8DCDD2D16BFFDB8DCDD2D16BFF 1.777 FFDBB2CDAC 1.828 CDACC0CDACC0 1.866 C0CDE6B2D1CB3E 1.896 E6FBC0CDE6FBC0CD 1.919 A3D187E6FBC0CDCB3E 1.939 85CBE6FBD285CBE6FBD2 1.969 CD83EAFBD2D1CD83EAFBD2D1 2.133 5F ``` 这个算法哪些有依据，哪些没有： - 只算一级衍射，没有算亮度、背景和零级。我们的另一个模型试过算这些，对色相几乎没有帮助。 - 光栅方程在旧的色板盘上有依据：纹理 `92` 按它预测，11 张照片 217 个观测的色相中位误差 22.2°（打乱基线 68.2°）。但这是看过数据后才定的方法。预注册的留出检验没有通过（46.8°，门槛 30°）。 - `92` 以外的周期，旧数据很少。`B9` 的颜色至今没有完全解释。 - 这 58 个序列在这张盘之前都没上过盘，这张盘也没有逐个测过它们的颜色。 - 这张盘的照片不是在设计位置拍的，灯也不一样，所以不能算对这个算法的检验。
技术细节 - 选色关系：`波长 = 周期 × δ`，δ 是光源和相机方向的单位向量之和在轨道切向上的分量。轨道方向固定，能选的只有沿轨周期。 - 58 种字节序列由 EFMPlus 编码器模型搜索，周期 0.85 到 2.13 µm，这是它们第一次上盘。 - 小格约 0.06 mm 径向、0.075–0.16 mm 切向，红蓝格按原图的红、蓝通道做误差扩散。 - 盘：RITEKF1 DVD-R，光驱 LG GH70N。设计机位：盘心外 13.5 cm、高 54 cm，手机闪光灯。实际拍摄不在这个机位。 - 颜色读数（手机 JPEG，手选小区域）： | 区域 | 色相 | 饱和度 | |---|---:|---:| | 原图花瓣 | 约 275° | 0.63 | | 右图，主玫瑰中部 | 271° | 0.59 | | 右图，主玫瑰花心 | 263° | 0.60 | | 右图，左下玫瑰 | 296° | 0.95 | | 右图，主玫瑰上部 | 328° | 0.71 | | 右图，右上 | 约 15° | 0.66 | | 中图，相距很远的三处花瓣 | 308° 到 322° | 0.98 到 0.99 | 中图的饱和度很可能是 JPEG 截断（绿色通道几乎为 0）。亮度约 0.25 对原图 0.62。
Colour algorithm (experimental) This is how we currently work out the patterns. It's experimental, and we can't promise it holds on another disc or from another position. ``` p = point on the disc, t = unit tangent of the track there u_L, u_C = unit vectors from p to the light and the camera delta = |(u_L + u_C) · t| P_red = 0.625 / delta # um P_blue = 0.455 / delta if P_red <= 2.133 and P_blue >= 0.853: # colour is possible here want_r = R / scale # R, B are linear values of the original want_b = 1.6 * B / scale # the red line is stronger, so more blue error diffusion: if max(want_r, want_b) > 0.5 pick a red or blue cell, else dark a red cell uses the sequence closest to P_red, a blue cell closest to P_blue else: error diffusion on brightness: light or dark # top and bottom areas ``` - `scale` is the 99.5th percentile of `R + 1.6 B` in the original. 1.6 is a compromise: a little measured data has the red line about twice as strong as blue, while the model has them about equal. - Design position: the camera 13.5 cm out from the disc centre and 54 cm high, with the flash offset from the lens by (−43.66, +19.79) mm, from Apple's dimensional drawing. - Cells are about 0.06 mm radially and 0.075 to 0.16 mm along the track. - The sequences are the list in the Chinese section above (period in µm and bytes after scrambling, written repeatedly). In the model, 58% to 69% of the power is in the line, and F512 is at most 0.37%. What this does and doesn't rest on: - It only computes the first diffraction order, not brightness, background or the zero order. Another model of ours tried those and barely helped with hue. - The grating equation has support from an older swatch disc: predicting texture `92` gave a median hue error of 22.2° over 217 observations in 11 photos (shuffled baseline 68.2°). But we fixed that method after seeing the data. A pre-registered held-out test did not pass (46.8°, threshold 30°). - There's little older data for periods other than `92`. The colour of `B9` still isn't fully explained. - None of the 58 sequences had been on a disc before this one, and this disc didn't measure their colours one by one. - The photos of this disc weren't taken at the design position or with the same light, so they don't test this algorithm.
English When you burn a picture onto a disc, the software normally turns a colour image into black, white and grey first. The colour you see on the disc is its own rainbow reflection, not something you chose. On this disc we tried another way: decide the colour first, then work out what to burn for each small area. It's a normal burner and a normal blank disc, with no hardware changes. At the right angle, some petals come close to the original purple. This is an early result from one disc. The limits are listed below. Left: the original picture, made with GPT Image. Middle and right: photos of the burned disc, background masked (images above). **Where the colour comes from.** The rainbow on a disc comes from fine repeating patterns. Different spacing shows a different colour in a given direction, and the data you write can change that spacing. So we fix where the camera and light will be, then pick a spacing for each small cell that sends red or blue light towards the camera. Red and blue cells mixed together look purple. Each spot on the disc needs its own spacing, so each small area is worked out separately. **What it looks like now.** - In the right photo, the middle and centre of the main rose are almost the same colour as the original, only darker. - In the same photo, the top of the main rose is more of a rose-red and the upper right is orange-red, so the whole picture isn't right yet. - In the middle photo, the petals are a rose-red, redder than the original. Distant petals are close in colour to each other, so the per-area calculation seems to be working. - If you tilt it gently, large areas change colour together, from green to red. That looks good in its own right. - The picture has a frosted look we didn't expect. We don't know why yet. **What it can't do yet.** - It only looks right from one angle. Moving the phone a little turns petals green or red. It's closer to a picture you view from one spot than to a print. - Two wedges of the disc can't show this colour, so the top and bottom of the picture are only light and dark. - So far we've only aimed for this purple. It isn't "true colour" that can show anything. - We found the angle by hand. The light was an iPad torch, not the phone flash we calculated for, and we didn't measure where it was. An earlier close-up photo didn't match the calculation, so we can't say the calculation is confirmed. - This is one disc and a few phone photos, and the phone's own colour processing affects what you see. - Our program isn't published yet. We'd like to clean it up and test it first. The same disc also holds 1.38 GB of data. That's a separate story: [#170](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/170). Earlier discussion: [colour #108](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/108). The numbers are in the technical details above.

title: 自制12cm DVD 半自动标定工具
body: 基于 #49 相关原理开发的半自动标定工具 **_理论情况下只需要消耗两张空盘即可准确获得标定数据_** 当前只兼容了12cmDVD，但原理对CD与BD通用 欢迎试用与二次开发 [DVD Calibrator Desktop](https://github.com/EternalEve/dvd-calibrator-desktop)

nodes.body: 杂牌碟的黑白半盘都能成这样，分析密环完全分析不出来，感觉放弃抢救了。
看着挺清晰，不应该吧

> 看着挺清晰，不应该吧

在分析密环那一步得到的软件反馈，紫线无法出现。
"可见图案证据不足。补拍清晰、少反光目要盖内中外的记录面照片：保留必要遮罩，再重新分析。"
补充图片：

@anyezhixie 如果拍照分析这一步一直过不去，也可以试试不靠照片的办法：[disc-probe](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe) 用光驱读取的时间差来量几何。它需要先刻一张随机数据盘，最好和要刻图的盘同一批。不是每台光驱都合适，先跑 `timing` 就能看出来。量出来的参数可以导出成 DIS 预设。使用情况和各台光驱的结果都在 [#107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107)，有问题也可以在那里问。

杂牌盘我们测得不多，不保证有效，只是多一条路。

title: 征集标定盘照片，用于改进照片自动标定（DVD）/ Call for calibration disc photos to improve automatic photo calibration (DVD)
body:
我在做一个 DVD 自动标定工具（[PR #62](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/62)）：刻一张自带编码的标定图案，用手机拍几张照片，程序直接解出这张盘的实际内外半径，不用手动描点。这个工具的定位和合并方向在 #123 讨论。

目前我只在一台光驱和一张盘上实测过，真实照片也只有十几张，所以想请大家帮忙刻盘、多拍些照片发上来。

**大约两张盘就能完成标定：** 第一张刻好后拍照解算，第二张用解出的参数重刻并确认效果。第二张换上新半径，重新运行一遍第 2 步就行。

**你需要准备：** 同一批的 12 cm 单层 DVD（DVD±R 或 DVD±RW）大约两张，DVD±RW 可以擦除后重刻，一张就够；另外还需要一台 DVD 刻录机和一部手机。

**照片的用途：** 只用来改进算法。我会尽力帮你解算，并回帖给你一份标定文件（内外半径等参数）。不保证每张盘都解得出来，也不保证回复及时；解出的参数还需要你刻盘验证。

## 第 1 步：查扇区数

每种盘的扇区数不同，请用自己盘的值，不要照抄下面的 `2298496`。

- **Windows：** 放入空白盘，在 DIS 的辅助标定页点**从光盘读取**。
- **Linux：** 运行 `cdrskin dev=/dev/sr0 -minfo`，查看盘片报告的容量。

## 第 2 步：生成 ISO

1. 安装 [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)，然后生成标定图案 `target_code.png`。PR 还没合并，所以这里先运行我 fork 上的固定版本（tag `calib-photos-v1`）：

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/HiroGitea/DiscImageStudio@calib-photos-v1#subdirectory=tools/disc-calib" disc-calib pattern --inner-radius-mm 24.08441 --outer-radius-mm 58.14365 --output target_code.png
```

2. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/releases) 下载 v1.4.0 或更新版本。Windows 下载 `win-x64.exe`，Linux / macOS 下载 CLI 压缩包。
3. 运行下面的命令，把两处 `2298496` 换成你的扇区数。内外半径必须和生成图案时用的一致。

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
.\DiscImageStudio-v1.4.0-win-x64.exe solve `
  --image target_code.png --iso-output calib.iso `
  --total-sectors 2298496 --fill-sectors 2298496 `
  --lba 0 --psn-offset 0x30000 `
  --inner-radius-mm 24.08441 --outer-radius-mm 58.14365 --channel-bit-nm 133.3 `
  --algorithm dispersion --fast-output true --fast-parallelism 0 --initial zero
```

Linux / macOS：

```sh
./disc-image-studio solve \
  --image target_code.png --iso-output calib.iso \
  --total-sectors 2298496 --fill-sectors 2298496 \
  --lba 0 --psn-offset 0x30000 \
  --inner-radius-mm 24.08441 --outer-radius-mm 58.14365 --channel-bit-nm 133.3 \
  --algorithm dispersion --fast-output true --fast-parallelism 0 --initial zero
```

生成的 `calib.iso` 大小应等于“扇区数 × 2048”字节，同名的 `calib.iso.json` 请保留。

## 第 3 步：刻录

**Linux：cdrskin（作者实测）**

```sh
# 只有重刻 DVD-RW 时才需要先擦除
cdrskin dev=/dev/sr0 -v blank=deformat_sequential_quickest

cdrskin dev=/dev/sr0 -v speed=2 -sao -eject calib.iso
```

我用 2 倍速刻满一张盘，大约 30 分钟。我的光驱是 USB 外置的，必须接外部电源，否则刻录时会掉线。

**Windows 自带刻录（作者未实测）**

右键 `calib.iso`，选择“刻录光盘映像”，选好光驱后开始刻录。Windows 11 可能要先点“显示更多选项”。

**ImgBurn（作者未实测）**

选择 “Write image file to disc”，打开 `calib.iso`，写入速度选盘片支持的较低档位。

刻完后光驱可能读不出这张盘，这不一定代表刻坏了，请先拍照看看。

## 第 4 步：拍照

请尽可能多拍同一张标定盘，**完整的整张盘和局部特写都要**。下面是我用 iPhone 拍两张盘的经验，样本很小，仅供参考。我拍的 12 张里只有 5 张可读，所以照片越多越好。

- **整张盘：** 外缘和中心孔都要拍全，手和其他物体不要挡住盘面。多换几种灯光和角度。
- **局部特写：** 靠近拍清楚内圈、中圈、外圈的环和码块。
- **尽量正对：** 倾斜控制在 15° 以内。
- **整盘要够大：** 整盘照片里，盘的直径最好占 3000 像素以上。
- **避开大块反光：** 不要让反光盖住细密的码块。彩虹带没有关系。
- **保留原图：** 不裁剪、不加滤镜，JPEG 和 HEIC 都可以。

这组半径是从我那张盘解出来的，你的盘可能差很多，图案可能严重扭曲，甚至只看得到环和细纹。这种照片同样有用，请一起发上来。

## 第 5 步：回帖

把原图打包成 zip 附在回帖里，并填写下面的信息：

```text
光驱型号：
盘的品牌和类型（如有 MID 也请写上）：
扇区数：
生成图案用的内外半径：
刻录方式和倍速：
肉眼看到的效果：
```

---

I'm working on an automatic DVD calibration tool ([PR #62](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/62)). You burn a self-locating target and take a few phone photos, and the tool solves the disc's actual inner and outer radii with no manual point picking. Its role and merge direction are being discussed in #123.

So far I have only tested it on one drive and one disc, with just over a dozen real photos, so I'm asking for help: burn a disc and share as many photos as you can.

**Calibration takes about two discs:** burn the first and solve it from photos, then burn the second with the solved parameters to confirm the result. For the second disc, repeat step 2 with the new radii.

**You need:** about two 12 cm single-layer DVDs from the same batch (DVD±R or DVD±RW; one DVD±RW is enough, since it can be erased and burned again), a DVD burner and a phone.

**How photos are used:** only to improve the algorithm. I'll do my best to run the solver and reply with a calibration file (inner and outer radii and related parameters). I can't promise that every disc will solve or that I'll reply quickly, and you should verify the parameters with a burn.

## Step 1: Find your sector count

Sector counts vary by disc, so use your own value rather than the `2298496` below.

- **Windows:** insert the blank disc and click **Read from disc** on DIS's calibration page.
- **Linux:** run `cdrskin dev=/dev/sr0 -minfo` and check the capacity the disc reports.

## Step 2: Generate the ISO

1. Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), then generate the target `target_code.png`. The PR isn't merged yet, so for now this runs a fixed version from my fork (tag `calib-photos-v1`):

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/HiroGitea/DiscImageStudio@calib-photos-v1#subdirectory=tools/disc-calib" disc-calib pattern --inner-radius-mm 24.08441 --outer-radius-mm 58.14365 --output target_code.png
```

2. Download v1.4.0 or newer from [Releases](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/releases): `win-x64.exe` on Windows, or the CLI archive on Linux and macOS.
3. Run the command for your system from the Chinese section above, replacing both `2298496` values with your sector count. The radii must match the ones used to generate the target.

`calib.iso` should be exactly sectors × 2048 bytes. Please keep `calib.iso.json` next to it.

## Step 3: Burn

- **Linux, cdrskin (tested by me):** use the commands above. A full disc took about 30 minutes at 2x. My USB drive needs external power, or it disconnects while burning.
- **Windows built-in burner (not tested by me):** right-click `calib.iso` and choose "Burn disc image". On Windows 11 you may need "Show more options" first.
- **ImgBurn (not tested by me):** choose "Write image file to disc", open `calib.iso`, and pick a low write speed that the disc supports.

The drive may not be able to read the disc afterwards. That doesn't necessarily mean the burn failed, so take photos anyway.

## Step 4: Take photos

Please take as many photos of the same calibration disc as you can, **including both whole-disc shots and close-ups**. These tips come from iPhone photos of two discs, so treat them as guidance. Only 5 of my 12 photos were readable, so more is better.

- **Whole disc:** include the full outer edge and center hole, with no hands or objects covering it. Vary the lighting and angle.
- **Close-ups:** get in close and capture the rings and code blocks at the inner, middle and outer areas.
- **Shoot nearly square-on:** keep the tilt under 15°.
- **Fill the frame:** in whole-disc shots, aim for a disc diameter of at least 3000 pixels.
- **Avoid large reflections** over the fine code blocks. Rainbow bands are fine.
- **Keep the originals:** no cropping or filters. JPEG and HEIC both work.

These radii were solved from my disc, and yours may differ a lot. The pattern may look badly twisted, or show only rings and fine stripes. Those photos are useful too, so please include them.

## Step 5: Reply

Attach the original photos as a zip and fill in:

```text
Drive model:
Disc brand and type (MID if you have it):
Sector count:
Inner and outer radii used to generate the target:
Burning method and speed:
What you can see on the disc:
```

title: 雜牌光碟，校正流程紀錄 Calibration notes for a no-name DVD-R
body: **_English version below 👇_** 花費4張雜牌DVD-R光碟，第5張完成，膽子大一點應該可以再少1~2張 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de0a4b33-5df6-4bc4-aea6-b089274d554d ## 參考 https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/49 感謝黑白圖片 https://sspai.com/post/118211 感謝流程貢獻 ## 校正0，以下簡稱C0～C# 使用 #49 的黑白圖片 + 普通24 x 58mm的規格直接燒第一片光碟，重要的是觀測其螺旋方向和螺旋線徑 通常會出一個非常密集的螺旋圖樣，用單眼觀察內圈的螺旋方向來確定要粗調小或粗調大 肉眼確定方向後，用預覽分頁改內外徑（通常都是調小） 確定螺旋方向和C0方向一致，進一步逼近螺旋圖樣 ### protip 也可以看一下內圈的螺旋粗細是否近似於外圈的螺旋粗細 **我的例子是C1內外徑都比C0 小，且粗細相似，則C1外徑縮減程度會比內徑大** > **另外在這裡許願新增預覽分頁的光碟預覽圖片縮放功能，好讓我從螢幕大小一致的比對pattrn** ## C1 > 內外徑 $23.96 \times 57.93$ 新開一個專案為C1，內外徑填寫剛剛預覽的內外徑，磁區和項次參數不用動 再燒一片剛才的黑白圖片，方向正確、參數粗調不要過頭的話扭曲程度應該就會大幅減少 繼續做到C2~C# **這時有可能你的粗調幅度會太大，導致螺旋方向反轉，務必確認好黑白兩區是否反轉** **用單眼和鑷子數螺旋圈數有奇效 ╰(*´︶`*)╯** ## C2 > 內外徑 $23.9665 \times 57.925$ ## C3 螺旋開始不繞一整圈時，就可以來燒內建的校正用標靶圖樣 然後依照 https://sspai.com/post/118211 「辅助标定-精调」小節進行精調 拍精調用的圖片時光碟可以放地上，手機開水平儀+閃光燈去拍 沒意外十字徑線就會被修正成正十字，膽子大一點可以套用完標定校準參數就直接出圖，收工 --- english version --- Used up 4 no-name DVD-R discs and got it on the 5th. If you're a bit bolder, you could probably save another 1–2 discs. ## References https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/49 Thanks for the black-and-white image https://sspai.com/post/118211 Thanks for the workflow ## Calibration 0 (hereafter C0–C#) Burn the first disc directly using the black-and-white image from #49 with the standard 24 × 58 mm parameters. What matters here is observing the direction of the spiral and the width of the spiral bands. You'll usually get a very dense spiral pattern. Look at the spiral direction in the inner ring with one eye closed to decide whether to coarse-adjust the radii down or up. Once you've confirmed the direction by eye, change the inner/outer radii in the Preview tab (usually decreasing them). Make sure the spiral direction in the preview matches C0, then keep refining until the preview approaches the spiral pattern on the disc. ### Pro tip You can also check whether the spiral band width in the inner ring is close to that in the outer ring. **In my case, C1 had both inner and outer radii smaller than C0 with similar band widths, so the outer radius was reduced by more than the inner radius.** > **Also, feature request: please add zoom for the disc preview image in the Preview tab, so I can compare the pattern at the same on-screen size as my photo.** ## C1 > Inner × outer radius: $23.96 \times 57.93$ Create a new project for C1 and enter the inner/outer radii you just fitted in the preview. Leave the sector count and polynomial-term parameters unchanged. Burn the same black-and-white image again. If the direction is right and you didn't overshoot the coarse adjustment, the distortion should be greatly reduced. Continue the same way for C2 through C#. **At this stage your coarse adjustment may be too large and flip the spiral direction, so be sure to check whether the black and white regions have swapped.** **Counting the spiral turns with one eye closed and a pair of tweezers works wonders ╰(*´︶`*)╯** ## C2 > Inner × outer radius: $23.9665 \times 57.925$ ## C3 Once the spiral no longer wraps a full turn, you can burn the built-in calibration target pattern. Then do fine calibration following the "辅助标定-精调" (Assisted calibration – fine tuning) section of https://sspai.com/post/118211. When taking the photo for fine calibration, you can lay the disc flat on the floor and shoot it with your phone's level indicator and flash turned on. If all goes well, the crosshair lines will be corrected into a straight cross. If you're feeling bold, you can go straight to burning your final image after applying the calibration parameters. Done!

title: 里面数据外圈文字制作
body: 所使用光盘Verbatim DVD+RW (94520)。参数于https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/issues/73 所示。 在Inkscape创建一个大小为(2\*r1) x (2\*r1) mm的画布，然后画出内外圈。布局上文字，再用一个绿色的圆标出里面的数据区，如下： 同时注意数据区的半径就是边界框的一半，109.605/2。 把所有无关的全隐掉，如下： 导出成1200dpi png，导入到这个项目软件中，效果就是这样： 使用这个公式计算出数据写入到上方绿色圆边界处所需的兆字节数： 生成ISO，假设把它放在/tmp/dvd-image-text.iso。开始写入光盘。 ```bash # 写入外圈文字 textpos=3904 f=/tmp/dvd-image-text.iso dd if=$f of=/dev/sr0 bs=1MiB oflag=dsync status=progress seek=$textpos skip=$textpos # 写入内部数据 f=<这里就能是其他随意数据或ISO文件了。但大小不能超过3904MiB> dd if=$f of=/dev/sr0 bs=1MiB oflag=dsync status=progress count=$textpos ``` 我用的公式是： - 已知物理半径r，求扇区数n：`n = N * ((r^2 - r0^2) / (r1^2 - r0^2))` - 已知扇区数n，求物理半径r：`r = sqrt(r0^2 + (n / N) * (r1^2 - r0^2))` 其中r0、r1为内外径。N是光盘总扇区数。 效果：
